title: thuja orientalis var. semperaurescens
intro: Thuja orientalis var. semperaurescens, commonly known as Western Red Cedar, is a coniferous evergreen tree native to North America. It has been traditionally used for its health benefits, which include anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antifungal properties, making it effective in treating respiratory issues, such as bronchitis and coughs. The therapeutic actions of Western Red Cedar include expectorant and bronchodilator effects, which help to relieve congestion and open airways. The bioactive constituents of Western Red Cedar include terpenes, such as thujaplicin, which are responsible for its antimicrobial and anti-inflammatory properties.
